title: Rueda moves 1 - Dame, Dame dos, Directo (easy changes)

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The lead instructor explains Rueda moves step-by-step to a circle of students while counting aloud. He demonstrates variations with the group and breaks down positioning details for beginners.

lesson_structure.note: Instructor introduces the Rueda class and the moves: Dame, Dame dos, and Directo.
Instructor leads the circle through Guapea and the first sequence with counts.
Instructor explains positioning tips for beginners regarding center rotation.
Practicing Dame super slow in the circle.
Introducing Dame dos, skipping one partner.
Repeating the routine from a different perspective.
Closing remarks and call to subscribe.

common_mistakes: Panicking and going forward instead of starting with the right leg back for girls

steps_taught.name: Dame
steps_taught.description: Rotating towards the center and changing partners.

steps_taught.name: Dame dos
steps_taught.description: Skipping one partner and moving to the next.

steps_taught.name: Directo
steps_taught.description: Swapping hands on 7 and going forward.

what_works: Clear verbal counts and cueing before each move
what_hinders: No front-facing solo demonstration of footwork

quotes.text: so the first will be dame, dame dos, and directo.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands outside the circle calling out counts while students dance in a circle formation.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact footwork details due to distance

extraction.distinctive_method: Teaching Rueda choreography directly in a circle formation with overhead camera tracking rather than individual footwork breakdowns facing a mirror.
